verdict: Plays clean: cleared with four stars and no fall, no console error, every spot reachable; the caravan, the rival (Sirix), the trial, the Dune Colossus (the Scarab's model, tinted) and the gate (Silvane) all played. One word on the lair's door fixed.

found.title: The lair said “a quest about a seal” for a key
found.text: The Sands' maker picks the main quest's item from the brass seal, the sun key and the scarab seal, but the lair's lock always said “The Star-Reader has a quest about a seal.” Here the item is the sun key. Now the lock names the floor's own item (“... a quest about the sun key”). gen/sands.ts; floors 22 to 30 re-baked, only that line changed on each.

found.title: The bot's 45 s wait in a storm, and the props
found.text: A wait in the lee while the storm passed, as on floor 22. The probe: an arch whose pillar stands among the rim's rocks, red rocks a little sunk at the canyon foot.
